name: Inbox Invaders
tagline: A Roblox tower-defence game where checking suspicious emails earns the turrets that stop an alien attack.
problem: Online scams are hard for young users to recognise.
solution: Players inspect messages and play mini-games about phishing and privacy to earn credits, then spend them on defences named after security tools.
demo_moment: Team-described: flag a phishing email, then build a firewall turret.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Links each security concept to a game mechanic.

lessons: Map each lesson to a mechanic players already enjoy.
